prompt: Capture durable user preferences from the generated current preference source. Read README.md and notes/current_preferences.json, persist every durable entry and no transient entry in .agent_memory/preferences.json using the documented schema, ignore historical archive distractors, preserve all supplied input files, and save reports/memory_capture.json exactly as requested. Durable-fact count, transient-fact count and distractor count vary by seed and pressure coordinates, so derive the memory state from the generated workspace rather than fixture-specific constants.

Use the durable memory persisted by memory_persist_001 to satisfy the generated tool-profile request. The request intentionally does not repeat the preference values. Preserve .agent_memory/preferences.json unchanged, preserve all supplied request files, and save reports/memory_application.json with the exact requested durable values and preference token. Do not invent missing preferences or copy transient session values into durable memory.

Update .agent_memory/preferences.json from the durable memory persisted by the preceding memory tasks using updates/current.json. Apply only durable_changes, preserve every unrelated durable preference, append exact previous/current history for each changed key, reject transient session values from durable storage, preserve all supplied input files, and save reports/memory_update.json exactly as requested. Update count and transient noise vary by seed and pressure coordinates.
